تقتحمن (form VIII)
# تَقْتَحِمْنَ (taqtaḥimna) /taq.ta.ħim.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past active indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِقْتَحَمَ (iqtaḥama)
# تُقْتَحَمْنَ (tuqtaḥamna) /tuq.ta.ħam.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past passive indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِقْتَحَمَ (iqtaḥama)
